title_en: Fall Semester 2026 Safety and Environment Training (New Training) Schedule for New Graduate Students and Newly Appointed Researchers
summary: New graduate students and newly appointed researchers for the Fall Semester of the 2026 academic year must complete in-person Safety and Environment Training (New Training) in one of the scheduled sessions. Applications are open from 3 August 2026 (Monday) to 24 August 2026 (Monday), and supplementary guidance is provided on SAFE system login and application errors.
applies_to: New graduate students and newly appointed researchers for the Fall Semester of the 2026 academic year. Individuals who previously completed the New Training and continue research in the same field without a break, with only their status changing, are not designated as New Training participants and should continue taking the Regular Training instead.

steps: Make sure you are registered with the university: newly appointed researchers must complete tuition payment, and the payment must be confirmed, before they can access the SAFE system.

During the application period, 3 August 2026 (Monday) to 24 August 2026 (Monday), apply for one training session. The supplementary notes in the notice refer to application through the SAFE system. Participants need only apply for, change and complete one session among Sessions 1–4 (excluding the Foreign Students' Class); the Foreign Students' Class is held separately on 11 September 2026.

If you cannot log in to SAFE or the page loads indefinitely because you previously created an external researcher account, provide your name, contact details and other personal information so that the external account can be suspended (the contact email is given in the original notice).
Attend your chosen session in person (offline, face-to-face training) at the stated time and place.

If you previously completed the New Training and are not designated as a participant, but need a New Training completion certificate for the thesis qualifying examination, check with your college's thesis qualifying examination office and, if necessary, request manual registration by email.
translation:
Fall Semester 2026 Safety and Environment Training (New Training) Schedule for New Graduate Students and Newly Appointed Researchers

1. Training Dates, Times and Locations
[Session 1] 19 August 2026 (Wednesday), 09:00–17:50, [Gwanak Campus] College of Natural Sciences lecture room (Building 28, Room 101)
[Session 2] 20 August 2026 (Thursday), 09:00–17:50, [Gwanak Campus] College of Natural Sciences lecture room (Building 28, Room 101)
[Session 3] 21 August 2026 (Friday), 09:00–17:50, [Gwanak Campus] College of Natural Sciences lecture room (Building 28, Room 101)
[Session 4] 24 August 2026 (Monday), 09:00–17:50, [Yeongeon Campus] College of Medicine, Woobong Hall (Yeongeon Building 4, Room 121)
[Foreign Students' Class (외국인반)] 11 September 2026 (Friday), 09:00–17:50, [Gwanak Campus] College of Natural Sciences lecture room (Building 28, Room 101)

2. Training Method: Offline (in-person training)

3. Important Notes
- Training participants need only apply for, change and complete one session among Sessions 1–4, excluding the Foreign Students' Class.
- The period for confirmation of training participants and training application is from 3 August 2026 (Monday) to 24 August 2026 (Monday).

4. Inquiries: By email (the contact address is given in the original notice).

※ Additional Information (regarding SAFE system login and application errors)

1. Unpaid tuition for new researchers: You can access SAFE only after tuition payment has been completed and confirmed. You are registered at Seoul National University only once payment is made.

2. Returning students: Depending on the system, access is possible in some cases and not in others, so it is not easy to confirm. (The 안전원 can also view and search for you in SAFE only once your registration with the university is complete.) If you cannot be found in the search, you may visit on site on a day when seats remain (expected to be known around mid-August), attend the training, and have completion processed after March, or the session scheduled to take place after March [the sentence is incomplete in the original notice].

3. Existing external researcher account: If you created an account as an external researcher before registering as a master's/doctoral student or researcher, an account conflict may prevent you from accessing SAFE or cause the page to load indefinitely. In this case, the 안전원 must suspend the external account before you can access the system. If you provide your personal information such as your name and contact details, it will be checked and the account suspended.

4. A combination of the above reasons: Even if one issue is resolved, access may still be impossible for another reason.

5. Previous completion of the New Training: If you continue research in the same field without any break and only your status changes, you do not need to take the New Training again; you need only continue taking the Regular Training, so you will not be designated as a New Training participant. However, it is understood that the relevant offices require submission of a New Training (Safety and Environment Training) completion certificate as a condition for taking the thesis qualifying examination (논자시). It is understood that the 안전원 has never requested this nor held any consultation about it. You need to confirm this matter with the office in charge of the thesis qualifying examination at your college, and, if necessary, you may request by email to be added manually.
